t: Listen to an announcement by an instructor in a classroom.
I'd like to announce that our guest, Professor Alissa Shevchuk from the History Department, has moved her lecture up from the eleventh to the fourth.
This means she'll be joining us in class next Wednesday.
Please click on the link in your syllabus to read Professor Shevchuk's article on nineteenth-century European nationalism in preparation for the discussion.
Visit my office hours or email me by Monday if there are any aspects of the article that you'd like Professor Shevchuk to address in detail.
